name: SurvivalSpecialWaveMonsterType - Default (seed v1)
description: A vanilla monster type of a special-wave profile, with its draw weight and first round.

steps.description: The special profile's own mix. A profile without any type uses the scenario's normal mix.

fields.label: Special-wave profile
fields.description: Filled in from the profile you are editing.

fields.label: Monster type
fields.description: A vanilla Minecraft monster type, e.g. ZOMBIE, SKELETON, SPIDER, CREEPER (stored upper case).

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: Draw weight among the selected types (default 1, equal chances).

fields.label: First round
fields.description: The first round this type can appear in (default 1).

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Leave empty to add it after the existing types.
